blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Batangas Second District Rep. Gerville Luistro is the House lead prosecutor for the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. This Tuesday, Luistro leads the prosecution team’s direct examination of witness E-Government Procurement Operations Division Chief Rendell Sopeña from the Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System (PhilGeps). Luistro, prior to being the lead prosecutor, also headed Duterte’s impeachment proceedings before the House of Representatives as the chairperson of the House committee on justice.
